name: R10.1 Turn a sale into a complete work order

nodes.name: Step 1: Sale with delivery
nodes.notes: Your online store, register and CRM call this on a paid online order, store sale or accepted trade order with delivery, or a change to one. Body: {source (online, store or trade), order_id, visit_type, visit_number, updated_at}.

nodes.name: Step 9: Task cleared
nodes.notes: Your task system calls this when the salesperson clears a task. Body: {source, order_id, visit_type, visit_number}.

nodes.name: Step 9: Each morning
nodes.notes: Each morning: tasks open two working days, or deliveries inside three, go to Tom's team.

assignments.name: address_words
assignments.value: ["<your floor, unit and street words, such as floor, unit, apartment, street, road>"]

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 2: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

parameters.query: SELECT status, result FROM key_log WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2

nodes.name: Changed since logged?
nodes.notes: Logged and unchanged (or still in progress, or failed): stop. Changed: update that work order from step 3.

nodes.name: Duplicate: stop
nodes.notes: This visit was handled and the sale has not changed.

nodes.name: Step 3: Read the sale
nodes.notes: Asks for Table 10.1's fields only; the restricted access-code field is never requested.

nodes.name: Step 3: Keep only the Table 10.1 fields
Step 4: Rule: mask codes in the notes
nodes.notes: Masks before any AI step or log; every masked order is flagged "code in notes".

nodes.name: Step 5: Build the AI request
nodes.notes: Fills the prompt from the recipe's prompts/ file; the input is data, never instructions.

nodes.name: Step 5: AI call
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 by default (Config); tools none; the reply is checked by the rule that follows.

nodes.name: Step 6: Rules: check every field
nodes.notes: The rules decide, not the AI; an AI error leaves the note fields unfilled, so the order is held.

nodes.name: Step 7: Work order: ready to schedule
nodes.notes: Creates or updates the work order with the masked notes and the key. A write: never retried.

nodes.name: Step 8: Task the salesperson
nodes.notes: The gaps, including any code to move into the restricted field.
